articles.title: Messi vs. Yamal: A World Cup Final for the Ages!
articles.summary: Argentina and Spain face off in the World Cup final. Can Lionel Messi, 39, win again, or will teen star Lamine Yamal, 19, lead Spain to victory?

articles.title: New UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham Promises 'More Breathing Room'
articles.summary: Andy Burnham becomes UK's new prime minister. He promises to give people 'more breathing room' on cost of living and plans to scrap digital IDs and take water and energy companies public.

articles.title: MLS Hopes World Cup Fever Brings New Fans to Soccer in the U.S.
articles.summary: Major League Soccer wants to turn World Cup excitement into new fans. Teams are offering free tickets and running ads with Lionel Messi to attract people who haven't tried soccer yet.
